body:
Reviewed the full three-dot diff for this exact head. The change centralizes the release build option set in `tools/cmake/PulpProfiles.cmake`, wires every release and rehearsal configure through `-DPULP_PROFILE=release`, rejects stale or contradictory caches, records profile provenance, and adds contract coverage for command-line, stale-cache, override, and provenance cases. The current required checks are terminal-green (excluding `review-verdict`), and I found no correctness or governance defect that warrants a hold. The Windows/Linux lanes are green; no platform-only follow-up is needed.
